decidedBy: the project owner's direction of 2026-09-29 that the encyclopedia is this project's own and BibleData is kept for events and the timeline, applied to the records the dataset heads with a word that is nobody's and no place's name — recorded on TSK-0428
policy: A record is a person, a place or a people the text names, or something this project has read for itself. A dataset's record headed by a common noun or a description, with no word, verse, line, tie or picture of ours on it, is withdrawn. What the dataset says of it stays in the dataset's own files.

records.why: The waters of Genesis 1 are a common noun, mayim, and the seas they are gathered into; the text names no place by it.
Genesis 1:10 calls the gathered waters seas, a common noun; the dataset itself lists no verse for the record.
Daniel 11:21 says a vile person shall stand up, and gives him no name; the heading is the dataset's paraphrase of the description, and whom it means is a reading the text does not state.
